nativePresentationPrimitives.drawer: @base-ui/react/drawer@1.9.0; owned source recipe independent of the consumer's shadcn style
nativePresentationPrimitives.dropdown-menu: @base-ui/react/menu@1.9.0; explicit app-shell dependency, not a style-selected built-in

sourceDistribution.mockupViewer: Host presentation for *.mockup.html, ported from spike/canvas-board at 3b838e3a5. Reuses viewers/InteractiveFrame and its opaque-origin policy. Lazy tailwindcss@4.3.3 compiler with generated upstream CSS sources and host-computed theme variables. Feedback uses host-owned proxy elements through the existing session picker/privacy boundary. No Pi execution or workspace authority.
sourceDistribution.actionMenus: thin host presentation adapters over the consumer's real shadcn Base UI dropdown-menu built-in; no home-made menu primitive or Pi lifecycle
sourceDistribution.editorControls: Markdown and HTML package renderers accept host component bindings; installed recipes supply consumer shadcn Button, Toggle, Input, Textarea and selection-bubble Card through the button item. The markdown-editor recipe owns its Markdown-specific Base UI view menu; viewers depends on that recipe to reuse its view-menu items and native shadcn Toggle formatting control. ViewerFrame mainControl is presentation-only header content that stays visible on phones. No execution or resource authority.
sourceDistribution.artifactViewer: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/artifact-viewer -> src/artifact-viewer.tsx; read-only host presentation of supplied content or media URLs. React and private Marked parsing over the shared passive HTML allowlist; no files, controllers, Tiptap, canvas, pdfjs or agent imports. Native browser PDF by default, with an optional trusted host renderer. No Pi execution or resource authority.
sourceDistribution.fileTreeControls: required host presentation binding; registry supplies the consumer shadcn Button, dropdown-menu and shared version-history rows, never a package-owned control skin
sourceDistribution.versionHistory: shared registry version-history presentation owns relative time, provenance and Current rows for viewer menus and Library panels; no publication or execution authority
sourceDistribution.chatActivity: the app's shadcn trace (its ui alias, installed in the app setup); host presentation over native Pi views, no execution state

chatComposition.pmFrames: AppShell's pm=standalone mode reuses the same pluggable PM on the app origin. Cross-frame pointing acquires one same-origin, same-app, identity-checked sibling page target; it reuses usePmPanel rather than a second picker/execution runtime. Only an explicit allowlisted parent (Studio by default) may supply validated theme tokens. No cross-origin DOM access, new route, CORS grant, or model authority is added.
chatComposition.backLayers: registry/utils/back is the single UI history owner shared by app-shell layers and pi-workspace artifact sheets; registry/app-shell/back preserves its existing public re-export. It owns no execution or durable decisions.
chatComposition.pmPanel: registry/pm-panel composes pi-app AgentWorkspace in embedded layout and pi-app-kinds over PiChat's existing controller and send-time feedback seam, the public feedback picker/privacy policy, and shared chat-react voice capture. AppShell improve mounts it once across routes: docked beside the app on desktop, full screen on phones except the point strip. History is useConversations, Library is the PM's existing read-only revision endpoint, and Tasks is a WorkspaceBar host panel. No model loop, second transcript, file store or execution ownership; host decisions remain authorized by their owner.
chatComposition.viewerUtilities: registry/utils/use-media.ts and persisted.ts own browser presentation only: one phone breakpoint below 768px, media subscriptions, visual viewport/keyboard inset and nonfatal session/local storage conveniences. No Pi extension point applies to local layout or browser storage; no kit subpath, package edge or execution state is introduced.
chatComposition.taskMentions: optional task-mentions registry adapter -> task-board + pi-chat-mentions; uses kit task records and existing MentionsConfig, composing an authorized task catalog with host file search/kinds. No npm/package edge, task backend, new composer, Pi lifecycle or pointing implementation; standalone task-board remains chat-independent.
chatComposition.pi-chat: regular native renderer; optional generic transcript, composer-content, file-pick and mention-option seams; no dependency on shared-chat
chatComposition.sentFeedback: pi-chat -> @hachej/boring-feedback/format for strict page-report parsing and readable element labels; host presentation only, no feedback capture, store, agent or Pi execution authority
chatComposition.voiceMessages: host microphone gestures over the opt-in chat-react/voice useVoiceAttempt, useDictation, useVoiceMessage and useChatVoice; one fenced capture lifecycle and timer over the neutral UI voice-capture entry, one workspace upload and transcript in one native submission; refusal label keys live in chat-text; no feedback capture dependency or second transcript store
chatComposition.shared-chat: optional registry item depending on pi-chat and the existing theme tokens; owns multi-party headers, cards, quotes, member mentions, host traces and localized labels; AgentWorkspace is composed through its existing chat and controls props
chatComposition.agentColour: shared-chat hashes agent IDs into the five standard shadcn chart tokens; icons use the token and text uses only default-theme AA-qualified palette entries. The theme owns the missing standard chart defaults/bindings, not a feature palette; no host override or new semantic token.
chatComposition.controllerTypes: native-chat exports the structural presentation contract; concrete native controller APIs and recovery are unchanged
chatComposition.chatReact: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/chat-react -> src/chat-react.ts; opt-in React hooks over the existing controller subscribe/getSnapshot: selectors, transcript windows and row chunks (host shadcn MessageScroller remains the scroll owner), draft persistence, placement, remote chat and conversations clients, common per-selection controller ownership, headless useChatSession state/files/send/restore/queue/uploads/paste/model-effort (src/chat-react-session.ts; injected labels and host callbacks, registry session adapter owns JSX only), artifact follow and present mount acknowledgements; src/chat-react-*.ts holds the implementations. Uses existing native-chat/remote-chat runtime and shared-chat types; no new store or Pi execution lifecycle, never exported by the headless root
chatComposition.chatView: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/chat-view -> src/chat-view.ts and src/chat-artifacts.ts; artifact descriptors, parsing, versions (newest conversation result first), revision-equality follow and present acknowledgement rules; the pure chat view rules (native view to rows, the waiting-for-the-person predicate, natural preparing status, run notice words) over Pi types only, generic in card content; no React, files, agent or controller runtime, never exported by the headless root. pi-chat and pi-ambient import it and keep no copy
chatComposition.chatText: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/chat-text -> src/chat-text.ts; the pure chat text grammar (slash menu entries, @mention token writing and parsing, message pieces, file kinds, paste and append-to-draft rules); no React, files, agent or controller runtime, never exported by the headless root. The kit's shared-chat writes and finds member mentions with it; pi-chat, pi-chat-slash, pi-chat-markdown, pi-chat-voice, app-shell, feedback and agent-target import it and keep no copy
chatComposition.chatVoice: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/chat-react/voice -> src/chat-voice.ts; optional voice attempt/capture telemetry, dictation and message preparation over the existing native controller. Separate from chat-react so core chat never loads microphone capture; no new Pi execution lifecycle or headless-root export
chatComposition.runNotifications: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/chat-react -> src/chat-react.ts; foreground useRunNotifications and background watchConversation share one run-notice transition over the existing controller subscribe/getSnapshot. Transient notification store only; no Pi execution authority or lifecycle ownership. Localized notice text and question parsing are injected by presentation; never exported by the headless root
chatComposition.dataEntry: @hachej/boring-ui-kit/shared-chat -> src/shared-chat/index.ts; host log/source/socket/fake/errors only, never exported by the headless root; imports the existing transport outbox
